Learned counsel for the State also submits that on the date of order, charge-sheet was not filed but later on, charge-sheet has been filed on 05/09/2023.
Although, the order dated 21/07/2023 mentioning that charge-sheet has been filed is not correct.
Factual situation has no effect on the merits of the order, therefore, requested corrections are innocuous in nature.

On due consideration, the petition filed under Section 482 of CrPC is allowed and order dated 21/07/2023 passed in M.Cr.C.No.30152/2023 is corrected to the effect that Section 402 of IPC shall be read as Section 420 of IPC and the statement that charge-sheet has been filed in the order stands deleted.
The remaining part of the order dated 21/07/2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.30152/2023 shall remain intact.

This order shall be read conjointly with the order dated 21/07/2023 passed in M.Cr.C.
No.30152/2023.
A copy of this order be kept in the docket of M.Cr.C. No. 30152/2023.

ORDER This petition under Section 482 of CrPC is filed for correction in order dated 21.07.2023 passed in M.Cr.C.No.30152/2023.
It is submitted that during hearing of the bail application under Section 439 of CrPC, charge-sheet with regard to Crime No.307/2023 registered at Police Station Jhansi Road, District Gwalior for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC was not filed, but in inadvertently, the order dated 21.07.2023 passed in M.Cr.C.No.30152/2023 reflects that charge-sheet has been filed.
Further, the section of alleged offence is mentioned as Section 402 of IPC which should have been Section 420 of IPC.
The order requires correction to that effect.
